h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kirari Suleman Nagar

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Kirari Suleman Nagar

c: In Kirari Suleman Nagar, in outer Delhi, the school ground is often the largest open space in the neighbourhood, and schools are among the first to ask for an outdoor gym. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to schools, community centres, RWA parks and parks under the Municipal Corporation of Delhi in Kirari Suleman Nagar. Our machines are made in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,120 km away, and come to Delhi by road.

A school gym needs machines that students can use safely during a games period, with clear space marked around each one. It can also serve parents and neighbours if the school opens the ground in the morning. Delhi has very hot summers and smoggy winters. We install through our own team or a dealer in north India. Send us the ground size, the age group of the students and photos for a layout drawing.

items.q: Are outdoor gym machines suitable for school students?
items.a: Yes, for older students under supervision. The machines use body weight with no loose weights. We mark the clear space around each machine on the layout drawing.

items.q: Can the school gym also serve the community?
items.a: Yes, if the school opens the ground at set hours. Gentle machines such as twisters and Tai Chi wheels suit parents and older neighbours.

items.q: Do you deliver to outer Delhi?
items.a: Yes. We send the equipment from our factory in Vasai by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in north India.
